Question 7
?

Consider the ellipse centered at (3,−1) with horizontal radius 2 and vertical radius 3, as shown above. Which of the following sets of parametric equations, defined for θ∈[0,2π), traverse the ellipse once in the counterclockwise direction starting at the point A(5,−1)?

a
x=4cos⁡θ+3,y=6sin⁡θ−1
b
x=cos⁡θ−3,y=sin⁡θ+2
c
x=4sin⁡θ+3,y=6cos⁡θ−1
d
x=2sin⁡θ+3,y=3cos⁡θ−1
e
x=2cos⁡θ+3,y=3sin⁡θ−1
Submit
